driver_findings.singleton_invariant_HOLDS: With --seed-rows 6000 --concurrency 8 the driver reported triggerAWorkPerformingRuns=1, triggerASkippedConcurrentRuns=7, triggerACleanupAuditRowsWritten=1, triggerADeadlock40P01=0, triggerASingletonHeld=true. 0417 does what it claims.
driver_findings.harness_artifact_do_not_misread: At the driver's DEFAULT --seed-rows 200 the same volley reports 2-4 work-performing runs and triggerASingletonHeld=false. That is NOT a 0417 defect. cleanup_expired_data() completes in ~200-350ms on a lightly-seeded rig, which is shorter than the spread of lock ATTEMPTS across 8 calls, so late arrivals legitimately acquire the lock after the holder committed. Reproduced independently of the driver: 8 synchronised psql sessions (no PostgREST in the path) also yield 3 workers / 5 skipped. Seeding enough rows to make the critical section outlast the arrival spread is what makes the volley genuinely overlap.

driver_blocker.summary: The per-org and audit-purge phases seed audit_events 'past-boundary' rows at a date that is not past audit_events' retention boundary.
driver_blocker.evidence: cleanup_expired_data() uses INTERVAL '90 days' for webhook_delivery_logs, INTERVAL '1 year' for verification_events and ai_usage_events, and INTERVAL '2 years' for audit_events. The driver's seeded audit rows are dated 2024-09-28 — past the 1-year boundary but ~13 months short of the 2-year one. Result: 12,803 SOAK_PR2335_PROBE audit rows sit on the rig that four consecutive cleanup_expired_data() calls each report deleting 0 of.
driver_blocker.consequence: triggerBAuditSeededPastRowsRemaining never reaches 0, so triggerBAuditPurgeContractHeld=false; perOrgAuditEventsOrgAPastRemoved under-counts and perOrgCrossOrgKeepRowsRemoved stays at the -1 sentinel, so perOrgIsolationHeld=false. Two of the four T3 requirements cannot pass, on every cycle, for a reason that has nothing to do with 0417.
driver_blocker.fix: use the per-table retention interval when computing each table's past-boundary seed date (audit_events = 2 years). Code change to services/worker/scripts/pr2335-cleanup-singleton-driver.ts, which moves the PR head SHA and therefore needs an image rebuild + redeploy before the clock starts.
driver_blocker.also_needed: the driver's /health probe is unauthenticated and gets 403 against a no-allow-unauthenticated rig. Worked around here with the batch-A local auth-injecting proxy (authproxy.mjs) on 127.0.0.1:8791 and --target-url pointed at it; the driver accepts localhost.
